It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Chicago Bears -2.4 with a fair total of 45.2 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Chicago Bears run offence vs Philadelphia Eagles run defence, which sits +0.042 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
